beat: Monday evening Chotu encounter interruption and Tuesday Dhika private emotional aftermath
translationStatus: complete working local draft / author review pending

lines.original: Blushing, she moved back and sat down on the sofa....
lines.local: Sharmaate hue Dhika peeche hati aur sofa par baith gayi.

lines.original: Chotu: sitting down on knees, between her legs.... didi.... what happened... are you okay?
lines.local: Chotu ghutnon ke bal uske pairon ke beech baithkar: Didi, kya hua? Aap theek ho?

lines.original: Dhika: feeling very shy that she moaned,..... hmmmm yeah, I am okay dear... she smiled blushing.
lines.local: Apni aawaz nikalne par bahut sharmaayi Dhika muskurakar: Hmm, haan dear, main theek hoon.

lines.original: Chotu: what was that sound you made.......?
lines.local: Chotu: Woh aapne kaisi aawaz nikaali thi?

lines.original: Dhika felt so shy and so embarrassed at the same time. Other than her husband, now a teenager has made her moan.... she couldn't comprehend it herself, let alone explain it to Chotu.....
lines.local: Dhika ek saath bahut shy aur embarrassed thi. Apne husband ke alawa ab ek 19-year-old young man ne usse moan karwa diya tha; woh khud samajh nahi paa rahi thi, Chotu ko kya samjhaati.

lines.original: Lucky for her,....she was saved by a bell..
lines.local: Khushkismati se doorbell ki tarah phone ki ghanti ne use bacha liya.

lines.original: Dhika: haan aunty.... what happened... she breathed heavy...
lines.local: Dhika bhaari saans lete hue: Haan Aunty, kya hua?

lines.original: Aunty: Beti..... Pappu is asking for you and crying so much.. Can you please come....
lines.local: Aunty: Beti, Pappu tumhe maangkar bahut ro raha hai. Aa sakti ho?

lines.original: Dhika: oh yes,... yeah aunty... 2 mins, I will be there.....
lines.local: Dhika: Oh haan, Aunty. Bas do minute, main aa rahi hoon.

lines.original: Saying,...she kept the phone down and informing Chotu.... she rushed into her bedroom.... (  giggling a little)... and closed the door.
lines.local: Phone rakhkar Chotu ko bataya, halki hansi ke saath bedroom mein jaldi gayi aur darwaza band kar liya.

lines.original: Chotu too changed his dress and left with a bye.
lines.local: Chotu bhi apne kapde badalkar bye kehke chala gaya.

lines.original: Tuesday afternoon after returning from college.... the same thoughts that have been running on her mind since morning, ran again.
lines.local: Mangalvaar dopahar college se lautne ke baad subah bhar ki wahi soch dobara Dhika ke dimaag mein ghoomne lagi.

lines.original: That was the first time.... a cock, beside her own husband's, even though through shorts.... has made her moan.
lines.local: Uske husband ke alawa pehli baar kisi aur ka penis, chahe shorts ke andar hi tha, usse moan karwa gaya tha.

lines.original: She felt shy.... blush... even a little guilt and sad, all at the same time....... Her emotions were running high and did not let her decide on what happened was right or wrong......
lines.local: Woh shy, blushing, thodi guilty aur udaas sab ek saath mehsoos kar rahi thi. Emotions itne strong the ki woh decide nahi kar paa rahi thi jo hua sahi tha ya galat.

lines.original: At last, she decided to let go of all these for now.... and decided to get ready for the twins to come. As per their request, she asked them to come for tuition today.
lines.local: Aakhir filhaal in baaton ko side rakhkar twins ke tuition ke liye ready hone ka faisla kiya. Unki request par aaj bulaaya tha.
